subject: Position-feedback diagnostic route from S5 gate fence to lower corridor
scope: Private copied-client steering design only; no gameplay placement, movement-rate, combat, live server or DIT change.

sources.exact_location: original boot camp navmesh path query from (25.965,103.871,130.293) to lower corridor

observations.finding: The same post-gate control sequence produced accepted fence points (3.38281,100.04688,129.76953) and (25.96484,103.87109,130.29297), outside the fixed controller branches.

Original boot camp navmesh path from the farther fence point passes approximately (5.2,101.1,131.2), (2.8,100.1,129.6), then (-6.8,98.3,120.0). This is walkability geometry, not a final-live NPC route or proof of player collision clearance.

proposed_diagnostic.method: At the accepted 03-fence packet, normalize toward X [-1,5], Z [125,134] with 400–800 ms W or D pulses chosen from actual displacement. Use D only when Z trends low; prior D3.6 raised Z to about 145 and is too coarse. At X near 3 and Z near 130, use one bounded W800 probe, then W holds no longer than 3 s toward lower corridor. Continue only on new accepted Move packets.
proposed_diagnostic.bounds: For each normalization pulse require X progress at least 1 m west, Y [97,108], Z [120,140], valid gameplay focus and alive client; stop after two consecutive low-progress pulses or on envelope escape. Limit pulse count and elapsed time. Lower-route handoff requires X [-27,-10], Y [94,101], Z [110,125].
proposed_diagnostic.uncertainty: W/D 400–800 ms behavior from X 26 has not been client-tested; navmesh corners do not establish safe combat timing or final-live movement.

next_check: Implement the bounded feedback controller in the private copied-client harness, test the X 26 and X 3 branches, then require original Human talk prompt, Continue and persisted 1995 objective 2→3 before same-session corpse use.
